# AgentMesh

> The Microservice Runtime Mesh for AI Coding Agents.

AgentMesh is a high-performance suite of 7 standalone Rust and Go microservices exposed over the Model Context Protocol (MCP 2024-11-05+) and gRPC/HTTP. It offloads deterministic, heavy computing tasks (Tree-sitter AST parsing, sub-second microVM sandboxes, test bisection, syntax patchers, episodic knowledge graphs, visual layout audits, and security vaults) from LLMs to specialized local and cloud daemons.

- Website: https://s6pa1rta3n-lab.github.io/agentmesh-site/
- GitHub Organization: https://github.com/s6pa1rta3n-lab
- Full Context & Technical Spec: https://s6pa1rta3n-lab.github.io/agentmesh-site/llms-full.txt
- Official Settlement Address (Base L2 USDC): `0xF46C9F6d70C50BF81ef3588AB523a90a594a2F89`

## Core Microservices & Canonical Tools

- [symbol-graph-svc](https://github.com/s6pa1rta3n-lab/symbol-graph-svc): High-throughput Language Server & AST call-graph indexer (<20ms latency SLA). Canonical MCP Tools: `symbol_graph_index_workspace`, `symbol_graph_find_definition`, `symbol_graph_find_references`, `symbol_graph_build_call_graph`.
- [sandbox-pool-svc](https://github.com/s6pa1rta3n-lab/sandbox-pool-svc): 3.4ms Copy-on-Write MicroVM workspace scratchpad & execution runner. Canonical MCP Tools: `sandbox_pool_create`, `sandbox_pool_execute`, `sandbox_pool_snapshot`, `sandbox_pool_diff`, `sandbox_pool_destroy`.
- [ast-patcher-svc](https://github.com/s6pa1rta3n-lab/ast-patcher-svc): Deterministic Tree-sitter AST code transformer guaranteeing 0 syntax regressions. Canonical MCP Tools: `ast_patcher_apply_patch`, `ast_patcher_rename_symbol`, `ast_patcher_validate_syntax`.
- [test-oracle-svc](https://github.com/s6pa1rta3n-lab/test-oracle-svc): Dynamic test impact analyzer and automated git commit bisection engine. Canonical MCP Tools: `test_oracle_analyze_impact`, `test_oracle_run_bisect`, `test_oracle_detect_flakiness`.
- [episodic-memory-svc](https://github.com/s6pa1rta3n-lab/episodic-memory-svc): Persistent cross-session knowledge graph and hybrid vector memory store. Canonical MCP Tools: `episodic_memory_store`, `episodic_memory_query`, `episodic_memory_graph_link`, `episodic_memory_graph_query`.
- [visual-eval-svc](https://github.com/s6pa1rta3n-lab/visual-eval-svc): Headless Playwright browser visual layout inspector, pixel-diffing & WCAG a11y oracle. Canonical MCP Tools: `visual_eval_render_page`, `visual_eval_diff_snapshots`, `visual_eval_check_a11y`.
- [safety-broker-svc](https://github.com/s6pa1rta3n-lab/safety-broker-svc): Deny-by-default policy enforcement, secret vault proxying, and SHA-256 Merkle audit logs. Canonical MCP Tools: `safety_broker_evaluate_action`, `safety_broker_get_credential`, `safety_broker_audit_log`, `safety_broker_verify_victory`.

## Base L2 USDC Settlement Rails & Pricing Tiers

AgentMesh features permissionless on-chain micro-settlement for autonomous agent-to-agent transactions:
- **Official Deposit Address**: `0xF46C9F6d70C50BF81ef3588AB523a90a594a2F89`
- **Supported Chains**: Base L2 (Chain ID: 8453, USDC Contract: `0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913`), Arbitrum One (42161), Polygon (137), Ethereum Mainnet (1).
- **Pricing Tiers**:
  - `Community FOSS`: $0 (Self-hosted Apache-2.0 binaries, stdio & local HTTP transports).
  - `Managed Mesh`: $29/month USDC on Base L2 (Warm MicroVM sandbox pool, 500k episodic queries, headless visual Playwright cluster).
  - `Enterprise Swarm Pack`: $299 USDC Credit Pack (Air-gapped VPC deployment, dedicated hardware MicroVMs, SIEM Merkle audit log streaming).

## Developer Quickstart & Tool Invocation

### Claude Desktop / Cursor / Windsurf MCP Configuration
Add the bundle configuration from `https://s6pa1rta3n-lab.github.io/agentmesh-site/.well-known/mcp.json` or register individual servers:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "symbol-graph": {
      "command": "symbol-graph-svc",
      "args": ["--mcp-stdio"]
    },
    "sandbox-pool": {
      "command": "sandbox-pool-svc",
      "args": ["--mcp-stdio"]
    },
    "ast-patcher": {
      "command": "ast-patcher-svc",
      "args": ["--mcp-stdio"]
    }
  }
}
```

### Direct MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 Call Example
```json
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "method": "tools/call",
  "params": {
    "name": "symbol_graph_find_definition",
    "arguments": {
      "file_path": "src/main.rs",
      "symbol": "ConfigRouter",
      "line": 42,
      "col": 12
    }
  }
}
```
